 man —, woman of 🞄the third caste.
ārya-miśra, a. venerable, &c. &c. 🞄(as an honorific designation).
āryamṇa, n. N. of a lunar mansion.
āryā‿āgama, m. intercourse with 🞄a woman of the upper castes.
āryā-gīti, f. species of Āryā metre.
ārya‿adhiṣṭhita, pp. controlled 🞄by men of the higher castes.
ārya‿āvarta, m. land of the Āryans 🞄(between Himālaya and Vindhya): pl. its inhabitants.
